LanguageData.Raven_Item_Fluid.label: [Raven] Fluid
LanguageData.Raven_Item_Fluid.description: A carefully prepared fermented milk drink made by the Raven race, sweet, sour, and nutritious. It can be consumed directly or sent into an extractor for further purification. However, its extremely strong, peculiar smell makes it hard to swallow for most outsiders. Additionally, it seems to have a wondrous effect on the mind.
